title: Better Archeology Rotten Wood Begone!
description: Datapack that removes rotten wood and chiseled bone blocks from Better Archeology structures and villager trades
body:
## About

This datapack removes certain blocks from [Better Archeology](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-archeology) structures and replaces them with their oak or bone counterparts. It also removes them from villager trades.

Blocks replaced:
- Rotten Log, Planks, Stairs, ... -> Oak Log, Planks, Stairs, ...
- Chiseled Bone Block -> Bone Block

I did this because even if the blocks look like vanilla ones, they are still only used in those structures and are in my opinion a bit unnecessary.

## Notice

It might work for other versions of the game too.
